title: A Primer of the First Static
summary: Teaches a new Warrior to feel static gather in the palm, hold it, and snap it out as a single dry spark.

title: Drill-Book of the Spark Palm
summary: Drills the open palm and the flicked thumb as the first tools of a Thunder student, from a single spark to a twin snap.

title: Handbook of Charge and Release
summary: Shows how to gather charge slowly, hold it under the skin and let it go in one clean release without a burnt hand.

title: Workbook of the Quick Arc
summary: Trains the short arc that jumps from hand to target, with catches, hops and a prong split for the steady student.

title: A Primer of the Ozone Breath
summary: Joins breath to charge so the student can smell gathering static, breathe it into the limbs and breathe it out as a spark.

title: Handbook of the Grounding Stance
summary: Sets the feet and legs as a path for stray charge into the earth, with rooted guards and a stamping crackle.

title: Drill-Book of the Cracking Step
summary: Drills short hopping steps driven by a pulse of charge in the heel, from a quick pivot to a sparking stamp.

title: Workbook of the Thunder Clap
summary: Teaches a clap of the hands that turns stored charge into a sharp crack of pressure felt by anyone close.

title: A Primer of the Bright Fork
summary: Splits the single spark into a forked pair of prongs, first for reaching, then for catching and pinning a target.

title: Handbook of the Conducting Hand
summary: Teaches the hand to carry charge through held metal, a cord or a rod, and to lead hostile charge away from the body.
